title: fix(plugin-timeline,plugin-detail,app-shell): a data view keeps the answer to its current query when an earlier answer lands late (objectui#10684)
body:
Fixes #10684

Clause-②: no

## What changed

A data view's rows commit and its `loading` release now belong to the CURRENT run of its fetch only. Four views had no such check; each gets the smallest guard in the shape its own file already uses:

- `ObjectTimeline` (`object-timeline`): the rows commit (`setFetchedData`) and the `finally`'s `setLoading(false)` now read the `isCurrent()` run guard objectui#10663 added for the two `error` writes. The error writes are unchanged.
- `RecordReferenceRailRenderer` (`record:reference_rail`): its commits read only a component-lifetime mounted latch. They now also require the run's signature (`fetchedSigRef`) to still be the dispatched one. A re-run with the same signature returns before touching the ref, so the latch's promise ("a fetch that outlives a re-render isn't dropped") still holds, and a pin says so.
- `ReportView`: the data effect committed `setReportRuntimeData` with no check. Its two async branches now return a cleanup that sets a `cancelled` flag, and both commits read it.
- `RecordAttachmentsPanel` (`record:attachments`): `refresh()` is called from the effect, the upload handler and Retry, so it takes a run number (`refreshSeqRef`), and only the newest call commits `rows` or moves `status` off `loading`.

No dependency list, no `error` lifecycle, no export and no prop moves. Three `patch` changesets, one per touched package.

Why per-view guards rather than a shared hook (H4, four axes): (1) real need: each of the four is a reachable user path (a filter, record or report change while a read is in flight), and each is pinned below; (2) long-term fit: one guard per effect, in the shape that effect's siblings in the same package already use, so there is no new abstraction to own; (3) AI-error resistance: no metadata or published surface changes, and nothing tolerant is added; (4) no scope spread: four copies, under the five the order set for a private helper, no new export, hook, prop or gate.

## Pins, base against fix

Each pin holds every `find` open by hand and settles them in a named order (deferred promises, no timers). Each fix was committed first; the base leg put ONE source file back to the base commit `f905090a1`, proved it on disk by a marker count (the `objectui#10684` comments on HEAD: timeline 3, rail 2, report view 1, attachments panel 3; 0 after each revert), ran the pin, restored from `HEAD`, and proved the restore by blob hash and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

| Pin file | Base source | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `ObjectTimeline.supersededRows-10684.test.tsx` (through `SchemaRenderer`) | exit 1: rows case `currentShown=false, supersededShown=true`; loading case red (skeleton gone while the current read was in flight) | exit 0, 4/4 |
| `record-reference-rail.supersededParent-10684.test.tsx` (through `SchemaRenderer` + `RecordContextProvider`) | exit 1: `currentShown=false, supersededShown=true`; skeleton cleared early | exit 0, 4/4 |
| `RecordAttachmentsPanel.supersededRecord-10684.test.tsx` (through `SchemaRenderer` + `RecordContextProvider`) | exit 1: `currentShown=false, supersededShown=true`; loading ended early | exit 0, 3/3 |
| `ReportView.supersededRows-10684.test.tsx` (the `rows` ReportView hands its stubbed renderer, the harness `ReportView.dataSourceObjectKey.test.tsx` uses) | exit 1: `currentShown=false, supersededShown=true` | exit 0, 2/2 |

Each file also carries a lit control (a single read renders as before). Two cases pass on the base as well, by design: the timeline's "the current run ends loading when it throws" (H2's no-stuck-spinner half) and the rail's "a same-record re-render issues no second read and the in-flight answer still lands".

Declared narrowing: after the merge only the pins, their neighbours, type-check and the light gates were re-run, not the full package suites. The merged `origin/main` content touches none of this PR's files; CI runs the whole farm.

## Acceptance notes

Found while taking the census, outside it, not edited:

- `packages/fields/src/widgets/useRecordQuery.ts` (the query hook behind `LookupField`, `PeoplePicker` and `RecordPickerDialog`, field widgets and so out of this census): `runQuery` commits `setRecords` / `setTotal` and releases `loading` for every call. Throwaway probe (never committed): a filter change while the first read is in flight, the superseded answer resolving last ⇒ `currentShown=false, supersededShown=true`. Reported to the seat for filing.
- `@object-ui/react`'s published `useViewData` commits `setData` with no current-run check; no in-repo view consumes it.
- Not data views, unguarded, not measured: the app-shell `ObjectView` record-count read (a `$top: 0` count), and the metadata-admin `AssignedUsersSection` and `DatasetPreview`.
- `ObjectMetricWidget`, `ObjectChart`, `RecordAttachmentsPanel` and `LineItemsPanel` key a fetch effect on a `useCallback` identity (the AGENTS.md #10 shape). Dependency lists are outside this card; noted only.
